mapper.select: select a.item_cd ,i.item_name ,a.test_no ,a.doc_stock_qty ,a.reql_stock_qty ,a.diff_stock_qty ,a.etc ,a.real_stock_item_id from tb_real_stock_item a join tb_item_mst i on i.item_cd = a.item_cd where a.real_stock_mst_id = #{realStockMstId} order by a.item_cd, a.test_no
mapper.insert: insert into tb_real_stock_mst (real_stock_date, item_type_cd, area_cd, storage_cd, manager_id, reg_id, upd_id) values (#{realStockDate}, #{itemTypeCd}, #{areaCd}, #{storageCd}, #{userId}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: select count(*) from tb_real_stock_item where real_stock_mst_id = #{realStockMstId}
select real_stock_mst_id ,real_stock_date ,item_type_cd ,area_cd ,storage_cd ,end_yn from tb_real_stock_mst where real_stock_mst_id = #{realStockMstId}

WITH LastClose AS ( SELECT TOP 1 a.real_stock_mst_id, a.real_stock_date, a.area_cd, a.storage_cd, a.item_type_cd, a.tran_id FROM tb_real_stock_mst a WHERE a.end_yn = 'Y' AND a.real_stock_date <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND a.item_type_cd = #{itemTypeCd} AND a.storage_cd = #{storageCd} ORDER BY a.real_stock_date DESC, a.real_stock_mst_id DESC ), BaseStock AS ( -- 마감이 있을 경우 기준재고 SELECT m.area_cd ,m.storage_cd ,i.item_cd ,i.test_no ,i.reql_stock_qty AS stock_qty FROM LastClose m JOIN tb_real_stock_item i ON i.real_stock_mst_id = m.real_stock_mst_id ), AfterTran AS ( SELECT v.area_cd ,v.storage_cd ,v.item_cd ,v.test_no ,SUM(v.qty) AS tran_qty FROM vw_inv_stock_tran v WHERE v.tran_date <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND v.item_type_cd = #{itemTypeCd} AND v.storage_cd = #{storageCd} AND (-- 마감 없음 → 전체 거래 NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM LastClose )OR -- 마감 있음 → 마감 이후 거래만 EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM LastClose lc WHERE v.tran_date > lc.real_stock_date OR (v.tran_date = lc.real_stock_date AND v.tran_id > ISNULL(lc.tran_id, 0)) ) ) GROUP BY v.area_cd ,v.storage_cd ,v.item_cd ,v.test_no )
SELECT COALESCE(b.item_cd, t.item_cd) AS item_cd ,i.item_name ,COALESCE(b.test_no, t.test_no) AS test_no ,COALESCE(b.storage_cd, t.storage_cd) AS storage_cd ,ISNULL(b.stock_qty, 0)+ ISNULL(t.tran_qty, 0) AS docStockQty ,0 as reqlStockQty ,'' etc --,COALESCE(b.area_cd, t.area_cd) AS area_cd --,ISNULL(b.stock_qty, 0) AS base_stock_qty --,ISNULL(t.tran_qty, 0) AS tran_qty FROM BaseStock b FULL OUTER JOIN AfterTran t ON t.area_cd = b.area_cd AND t.storage_cd = b.storage_cd AND t.item_cd = b.item_cd AND ISNULL(t.test_no, '') = ISNULL(b.test_no, '') JOIN tb_item_mst i ON i.item_cd = COALESCE(b.item_cd, t.item_cd) ORDER BY COALESCE(b.item_cd, t.item_cd) ,COALESCE(b.test_no, t.test_no)

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY q.item_cd, q.test_no, q.storage_cd) AS row_id ,q.* from ( select c.code_nm as item_type_name ,a.item_cd ,a.item_name ,a.test_no ,sum(isnull(a.qty, 0)) as qty ,s.storage_name ,a.storage_cd ,a.item_type_cd from vw_inv_stock_tran a left join tb_common_code c on c.code = a.item_type_cd and c.com_type_cd = 'item_type_cd' left join tb_storage_mst s on s.storage_cd = a.storage_cd where a.item_type_cd = #{itemTypeCd} and a.item_cd LIKE '%#{itemCd}%'
and a. item_name LIKE '%#{itemName}%'
and a.test_no LIKE '%#{testNo}%'
group by c.code_nm ,a.item_cd ,a.item_name ,a.test_no ,s.storage_name ,a.storage_cd ,a.item_type_cd ) q ORDER BY q.item_cd, q.test_no, q.storage_cd
mapper.insert: insert into tb_real_stock_item ( real_stock_mst_id, item_cd, test_no, doc_stock_qty, reql_stock_qty, diff_stock_qty, etc, reg_id, upd_id) values (#{realStockMstId}, #{itemCd}, #{testNo}, #{docStockQty}, #{reqlStockQty}, #{diffStockQty}, #{etc}, #{userId}, #{userId})
